Name: Yuns Expanded Farms
Author: BrokbrnYun
Description:
[b][size=4]1.6 Compatiable!![/size][/b]


The maps listed have either a Big or Slight expansion but each of them has a touch of love without just scaling the map up with no cool additions.

They are also great for multiplayer [s]or cult setups[/s] so yeah have fun

All of the Farms do not replace the Vanilla Farms. Each of the Farms have their respective Selection Window


Finished Farms
Beach Farm (Expanded)
Riverland Farm (Expanded)
Wilderness Farm (Redux)
Foraging Farm (Redux)
Hilltop Farm (Redux)
Four Corners (Redux)

Upcoming Farms
Four Corners (Expanded)
Hilltop (Expanded)
Foraging (Expanded)
Meadowlands Farm (Expanded) (This will be a looooooooong time till I add it)

[color=#ff0000]Important Info[/color]
Both the Host and the Connecting Users need to have said Mod installed 
(Please correct me if its only Host needing it)

Is this still being worked on?
Yes it is. Currently working with a Group of Friends on a Project which is taking a while

[color=#ff0000]How to Report Bug / Reach out [/color]
If you found smth that is maybe a bug please reach out on my Discord which is discord.gg/U6dvJN7w5g. Yes that is still the same Server. I just go under a different User on Discord now (If you see a user with the "Bread Role" thats me)

You can also still use the same old option as sending them on the Nexus Bug page but please keep in mind I do not check it as much.
